test_cases.name: explicit_contract
test_cases.desc: Source_Capabilities -> Request -> Accept -> PS_RDY establishes a contract.

test_cases.name: goodcrc_ack
test_cases.desc: Every message is acknowledged with GoodCRC before the next is sent.

test_cases.name: pps_request
test_cases.desc: Sink selects an APDO and programs an output voltage in 20 mV steps via the RDO.

test_cases.name: pr_swap
test_cases.desc: PR_Swap exchanges Source and Sink power roles after a contract exists.

test_cases.name: soft_reset
test_cases.desc: Soft_Reset resets MessageID without removing VBUS or the contract.

test_cases.name: hard_reset
test_cases.desc: Hard Reset forces VBUS to vSafe0V/vSafe5V and returns default power roles.

test_cases.name: crc_error
test_cases.desc: Corrupted CRC-32 -> no GoodCRC -> retransmission then Soft_Reset.
